**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Article V pricing is consumption-only: a declining fee rate per US$1 million actually traded, with the Monthly Notional Volume bands functioning as a volume discount (retroactively applied to all trades in the month) rather than as a floor. I confirmed there is no minimum volume, committed spend, shortfall charge or take-or-pay language anywhere in the agreement, and p0070 ties the amount payable to volume actually recorded as traded with the Licensed Technology. The 36-month Initial Period is a licence term only, so no reduction or exit right is needed for this rule. The remaining Licensee payments — the $35,000 initial payment, the $2,500/month support fee, and the 33% Supplemental Payments on third-party earnings — are charges for ordered services or a share of amounts we actually receive, not purchase minimums. The Licensor's rebate-share obligation runs in our favour and was not flagged.
